book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Soldi metam nadisukilitihinit yehitubu-kadaka tiyauguk

Unduŋ tubune Sol adi Stiwen ukiŋdok welemomooŋ nadiguk. Nai uŋaniŋgoŋ Jesu’walaŋ kayoŋbop Jelusalem maaneŋ hatiyagiŋ folofigita wapum yemiŋa yehitubu-kadakaune momoŋ Judiya eŋ Samaliya kwetneŋ udapmagiŋ, kaŋ Aposel heki hogok adi Jelusalem uŋoŋ hatigiŋ.
Kaŋ me noli Bepaŋ’walaŋ titiŋŋiŋ keleŋ tagiŋ adi Stiwen makunum timiŋa bemŋa wooŋ wenefulagiŋ.
Unduŋ tigiŋ kaŋ Sol adi Jesu’walaŋ kayoŋbop yehitubu-kadakawe yotyot indigoŋ looŋ me be tam Jesu nadisukilitimiyagiŋ yanagila wooŋ yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ yapmeluguk.
Samaliyahidi Jesu’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ nadiŋa nadisukilitigiŋ
Unduŋ tulune me Jesu nadisukilitimiyagiŋ adi kwetkwet wooŋ metam Jesu’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ yenihautagiŋ.
Kaŋ Filip adi wooŋ Samaliyahi’walaŋ yokwet wapumneŋ uŋoŋ Kilisto’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ yeniyeniŋ tiŋa

kudi tubune yabap kadakahi mehinek fe’walaŋ welehik maaneŋ yakawe wapum toŋa labuŋa buŋa wagiŋ, eŋ me noli foloohik diki kumuhi eŋ me noli talik mu yawagiŋ u yehitubu-kedebaguk. Unduŋ tubune metam adi kabup ilaŋa medeŋiŋ nadiŋa kudi u kagiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa metam uŋahi adi nadifo wapum tigiŋ.

Me niŋ uŋoŋ hatiluguk wou Saimon, adi nemek kahaŋkahaŋ moŋgo hatiluguk kaŋ metam uŋoŋ hatiyagiŋ adi Saimondok nadimimbune uŋgoniŋ hinek tuluguk. Me loloŋnit be fofoŋnit uŋoŋ itowagiŋ adi Saimondi nemek tuluguk u kabup hinek ilaŋa kayagiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa ne me loloŋnit hinek yoluguk kaŋ metam adi me i bepaŋ’walaŋ saŋiniŋ wapum yoiŋ uku kame hatilak yoyagiŋ.
Nai kweheyeniŋ hinek kwanai u titabuguk doktiŋa metamdi adi’walaŋ mede nadiyagiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ Filipdi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Uŋgoniŋ diniŋ eŋ Jesu Kilisto’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ yenimbune u nadisukilitiŋa me be tam Imeyout tigiŋ.
Kaŋ Saimon ne maaŋ undugoŋ nadisukilitiŋa Imeyout tiŋa Filip keleyauŋa Bepaŋ kunumneniŋ’walaŋ kudi mebimebi tiyauguk u yabuŋa nadiune uŋgoniŋ hinek tuguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa hatilu Aposel Jelusalem hatigiŋ adi Samaliya metam Mede Momooŋ nadiŋa Imeyout tigiŋ, adi’walaŋ kahathik nadiŋa Pita dut Jon yeniŋkulu ugumuk.
Wosuwaaŋ metam Jesu Kilisto wou gineŋ hogok Imeyout tigiŋ doktiŋa Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli foyembek yoŋa Bepaŋ ninadi kwanai tugumuk.
Tiŋa kohohik metam kihik foloŋ kameune Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli foyemguk.
Pita yakatdi kohohik metam kihik foloŋ kameune Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli moŋgolune Saimondi u yabuŋa muneeŋ Pita dut Jon yemiŋa yeniŋguk,
“Saŋiniŋ nutok maaŋ nambune kohone mehinek kihik foloŋ kamewene Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli moŋgokaneeŋ.”
Unduŋ yeniŋguk kaŋ Pitadibo niŋguk, “Du Bepaŋ’walaŋ welesiloŋ u muneeŋdi tuwadok nadisuŋa yolaŋ doktiŋa muneeŋge bumbut hamdok gigit tibaaŋ.
Du welegedi Bepaŋ’walaŋkade didime mu tilak doktiŋa indi kwanai tamut i diki du mu gohonewek.

Du saŋiniŋ undiniŋ u tiŋa da sigige tiloloŋdok nadilaŋ eŋ kadakaniŋ hogoli hinekdi gehifolokenelak doktiŋa nadihebetge hogoli i sigilulum timiŋa Wapumdi nadinadi kadakaniŋ undiniŋ tilaŋ u bigamdok ninadiweŋ.”
Unduŋ nimbune Saimondibo Pita dut Jon yeniŋguk, “Hidi Bepaŋ ninadiune nemek undiniŋ mu mintanambaak.”
Aposel yakat adi Wapum’walaŋ mede yeniŋa koti Jelusalemde ugumuk. Talipmeŋ uŋila Samaliya maaneŋ yokwet fee ila ugiŋneŋ wooŋ Mede Momooŋ yeniŋtaugumuk.
Filipdi Itiopianiŋ me loloŋnit niŋ Mede Momooŋ nindakaleguk
Adi unduŋ titaulune Filip adi Wapum’walaŋ aŋelodi buŋa niŋguk, “Tiulidoko tiŋa pilali talik Jelusalem wooŋ Gasa wosuwalak u keleweŋ.” (Talik u kwet fiileŋkade ulak.)
Unduŋ nimbune Filip adi tiulidoko tiŋa uguk. Wooŋ Itiopiahi’walaŋ Tam Wapme
diniŋ me loloŋnit, muneeŋ bomboŋ yabudoko tuluguk, adi Jelusalemde Bepaŋ niutumbawe uguk
ala kaliŋiŋ
foloŋ buguk. Talipmeŋ buŋila pepa niŋ koom polofet Aisaiyadi youkuk u kunatabuguk.
Kaŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi Filip niŋguk, “Du wooŋ kali ila ulakneŋ uŋgoŋ ya naditaweŋ.”
Unduŋ nimbune Filip adi kiyaneeŋ wooŋ yamaiŋgoŋ ya naditaulune me u polofet Aisaiyadi Youkudip tuguk u kunalu nadiŋa niŋguk, “Du nemek kunataŋ u maaŋbe nadidakalelaŋ?”
Unduŋ nimbune yoguk, “Na dediŋ tiŋa nadidakalewit yoŋa yolaŋ. Nebek niŋdi nanindakaleune kedem nadidakalewit oŋ.” Unduŋ yoŋa Filip nimbune looŋ noŋgoŋ ikumuk.
Mede kunakuk u polofetdi indiŋ youkuk.

content.text: “Me u nagila wooŋ dompa widihikumiiŋ unduŋ timiŋgiŋ. Adi nagi uune dompa mihiniŋ dumuniŋhik dobune mede mu toiŋ unduŋ tuguk,
eŋ yalaŋ niŋa folomeka wapum hinek miŋgiŋ. Adi hatihatiŋiŋ kwetfoloŋ iŋoŋ agaŋ dapmaguk doktiŋa nediyeŋdi kunali nadidakaleeŋ naŋgat dikiŋiye yenindakalewaak?”

content: Mede u kunali me muneeŋ yabudoko tuluguk adi Filip indiŋ ninadiguk, “Mede i netok be youkuk, be me niŋdok youkuk u nanimbu nadiwit.”
Unduŋ nimbune Filipdi uŋgoŋ tububihila Jesu’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ u niŋguk.
Nintafofoyeŋ ime niŋ gineŋ fosuwaaŋ me muneeŋ yabudokolugukdi Filip niŋguk, “Ime yoŋ, maŋgoŋdi Imeyout titiŋdok kamehep tinamulak?”
[Unduŋ yobune Filipdibo niŋguk, “Welegedi nadisukilitidapmaaŋ kedem Imeyout tibeŋ.” Unduŋ yobune yoguk, “Nu Jesu Kilisto Bepaŋ mihiŋiŋ u nadisukilitimilat.”]
Unduŋ yoŋa dalaiwa nimbu wosi tawahik hamaneune kali uŋgoŋ kilitiŋa yalune fooŋ Filipdi me loloŋnit u Imeyout timiŋguk.
Imeyout tubudapmaaŋ labune Wapum’walaŋ Munabulidi buŋa Filip nagila uguk kaŋ me loloŋnit adi kotigoŋ mu kaguk, tiŋa nadifo wapum tiŋa uguk.
Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi Filip nagi wooŋ Asdot kameune yokwet indigoŋ wooŋ Mede Momooŋ yotauyeŋ Sisaliya yokwetneŋ wosuwaguk.

footnotes.text: Kaliŋiŋ wou kalis, wosi hekidi yehihamaneeŋ yawagiŋ.
